ruleset.name: nitpicker-code-smells
ruleset.description: Nitpicker code smell rules for main sources.

rule.name: RepeatedStringLiteral
rule.message: This string literal is repeated three times or more in the file. Name it once as a constant (private static final String NAME) and use the constant.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //StringLiteral[not(ancestor::Annotation or ancestor::SwitchLabel)][string-length(@ConstValue) >= 5][matches(@ConstValue, '[A-Za-z0-9]')] [not(empty(preceding-sibling::*) and parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall/@MethodName = ('getMessage', 'getString'))] [let $value := @ConstValue return count(preceding::StringLiteral[@ConstValue = $value][not(ancestor::Annotation or ancestor::SwitchLabel)] [not(empty(preceding-sibling::*) and parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall/@MethodName = ('getMessage', 'getString'))]) >= 2]

rule.name: GenericTypeName
rule.message: Name this type for what it does (PriceRounder, OrderTotals), not Utils, Helper, Manager, Common or Misc. Pure logic shared between features goes in the shared package under such a name.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::InterfaceDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration] [matches(@SimpleName, '(^|[A-Za-z0-9])(Util|Utils|Utility|Utilities|Helper|Helpers|Manager|Managers|Common|Commons|Misc|Miscellaneous)$')] [let $suffix := replace(@SimpleName, '^.*?(Util|Utils|Utility|Utilities|Helper|Helpers|Manager|Managers|Common|Commons|Misc|Miscellaneous)$', '$1') return not((ExtendsList | ImplementsList)/ClassType[ends-with(@SimpleName, $suffix)])] [not(matches(@SimpleName, '(Authentication|Transaction|Cache|Entity|Session|Connection|Lock|Resource)Manager$'))]

rule.name: GenericPackageName
rule.message: Name this package for what it holds, not utils, helpers, common or misc. Pure logic shared between features goes in the shared package under a name that says what it does.

rule.name: HardcodedSecret
rule.message: This variable holds a hardcoded secret. Read it from the environment or a secrets manager and inject it.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $secret := '(password|passwd|pwd|passphrase|secret|token|credentials?|apikey|privatekey|accesskey|secretkey|authkey|signingkey|encryptionkey)$', $assigned := ( /*[preceding-sibling::*[1][self::StringLiteral][matches(lower-case(replace(@ConstValue, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '')), $secret)]] ), $values := ( $assigned | $assigned/self::ConditionalExpression/*[position() = 2]/ArgumentList/*[last()] | $assigned/self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'orElseGet']/ArgumentList/LambdaExpression/*[last()] ) return ( $values[self::StringLiteral] | rule.name: CredentialLiteral
rule.message: This string looks like a credential (access key, token, private key, or a password in a URL). Read it from the environment or a secrets manager.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //StringLiteral[ matches(@ConstValue, 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|-----BEGIN ([A-Z]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----|[rs]k_(live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk-(proj|ant|live|test)-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}') or matches(@ConstValue, '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://[^\s/:@]+:[^\s/@$\{\}]{6,}@', 'i') or matches(@ConstValue, '[?&;]password=[^&;\s$\{\}]{6,}', 'i') or matches(@ConstValue, '^(Bearer|Basic) [A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{16,}$')]

rule.name: SecretInLog
rule.message: A secret must not be logged. Log that it is set, or a masked tail, instead.

property.name: xpath
property.value: (//VariableAccess | //FieldAccess | //MethodCall) [matches(lower-case(replace(@Name, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '')), '(password|passwd|pwd|passphrase|secret|token|credentials?|apikey|privatekey|accesskey|secretkey|authkey|signingkey|encryptionkey)$') or matches(@MethodName, '^get(Password|Secret|Token|ApiKey|PrivateKey|Credentials?)$')] [not(matches(@Name, '^(has|is)[A-Z_]|^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$'))] [ancestor::*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'])][1][self::ArgumentList]/parent::MethodCall [@MethodName = ('trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'fatal', 'log', 'severe', 'warning', 'fine', 'finer', 'finest', 'println', 'print', 'printf')] [*[1][matches(@Name, '(^|\.)(log|logger|out|err)$', 'i') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.PrintStream')]]]

rule.name: CatchOnlyLogsOrReturnsDefault
rule.message: This catch only logs the failure or returns a default, and carries on. Rethrow it with the cause (throw new FeatureException(message, e)), return a failure result that carries the exception, or answer with an error response.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //CatchClause[Block[*]] [not(CatchParameter//ClassType[@SimpleName = 'InterruptedException'] and Block//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'interrupt'])] [not(Block//ThrowStatement)] [not(parent::TryStatement[Block[1]//(ReturnStatement | BreakStatement)] /parent::Block/parent::*[self::ForeachStatement or self::ForStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement])] [not(Block//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('status', 'internalServerError', 'badRequest', 'notFound', 'unprocessableEntity', 'sendError', 'exit')])] [let $name := CatchParameter/VariableId/@Name, $logged := Block//MethodCall [@MethodName = ('trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'fatal', 'log') or matches(@MethodName, '(^l|[a-z0-9]L)og(ger)?([A-Z0-9_]|$)') or (@MethodName = ('severe', 'warning', 'fine', 'finer', 'finest', 'println', 'print', 'printf') and *[1][matches(@Name, '(^|\.)(log|logger|out|err)$', 'i') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.PrintStream')])], $wrappers := ('valueOf', 'format', 'formatted', 'toString'), $direct := Block//LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/*[2]/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess[@Name = $name] [empty(ancestor::ArgumentList[parent::MethodCall[not(@MethodName = $wrappers)]] intersect ancestor::VariableDeclarator[1]//ArgumentList)], $names := ($name, $direct/ancestor::VariableDeclarator[1]/VariableId/@Name), $carrying := Block//LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/*[2]/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess[@Name = $names] [empty(ancestor::ArgumentList[parent::MethodCall[not(@MethodName = $wrappers)]] intersect ancestor::VariableDeclarator[1]//ArgumentList)], $aliases := ($names, $carrying/ancestor::VariableDeclarator[1]/VariableId/@Name) return not((Block//VariableAccess[@Name = $aliases] except $carrying) [not(parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'printStackTrace'])] [empty(ancestor::MethodCall intersect $logged)])]

rule.name: BooleanFlagParameter
rule.message: This boolean parameter switches the method between two behaviors, which makes the call site unreadable. Split the method into two methods named for each behavior, or pass an enum or a small record.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[@Visibility = 'public'] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Override'])] [not(matches(@Name, '^(set|with)[A-Z]|^(of|from|valueOf|builder)$'))] [ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::InterfaceDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration][last()][@Visibility = 'public']] /FormalParameters/FormalParameter[not(ModifierList/Annotation)][PrimitiveType[@Kind = 'boolean'] or ClassType[@SimpleName = 'Boolean']] [let $flag := VariableId/@Name return exists(../../Block//(IfStatement | ConditionalExpression)/*[1]/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess[@Name = $flag] [ancestor::*[not(self::UnaryExpression or self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||')])][1][self::IfStatement or self::ConditionalExpression]])]

rule.name: IoCallInLoop
rule.message: This calls a database, HTTP, file or repository API once per loop item (one query or request per item). Batch it: fetch or write all items at once (findAllById, saveAll, deleteAll, WHERE id IN (...), one batched request). Paging, polling and retry loops are fine.

property.name: springData
property.description: SpringDataNoSaveInLoop runs and reports Spring Data and JPA writes in a loop
